title: 18剑器舞19杀人的雾20竹叶青
content_zh:
风波平息，五人一仆结伴踏上江南征途。萧无恨、林之水、杨凡、蓝继仁、彭天横，再加上林之水身边的小仆秋桐，一行六人同行于江湖路，晓行夜宿，风雨相伴。
一路之上，山川秀美，风物各异，时而途经青山绿水，时而穿行市井乡镇。众人朝夕相处，谈天论地，饮酒把欢，从江湖轶事聊到诗词歌赋，从山川地理说到武林掌故。原本素不相识的几人，在朝夕相伴中渐渐熟络，意气相投，竟生出几分相见恨晚的知己之意。
点苍弟子杨凡，生性潇洒不羁，为人坦荡磊落，谈吐风趣不凡，胸中既有文人风骨，又有侠客豪情，遇事沉稳有担当，一路之上深得众人敬佩与信赖。
富商蓝继仁虽出身商贾，却全无铜臭俗气，为人古道热肠，豪爽大方，性子开朗随和，最爱与身边年轻人打趣说笑，时常逗得秋桐哈哈大笑，一路旅途因他添了不少欢声笑语，沉闷尽消。
他身旁的贴身护卫彭天横，则是另一番模样。这位五虎断门刀的高手，始终沉默寡言，右手始终稳稳按在腰间刀柄之上，寸步不离蓝继仁左右，一双虎目环眼，时刻警惕地扫视着四周动静，草木风声皆不放过，如同一尊沉稳可靠的守护神，将所有潜在危险隔绝在外。
林之水则一如既往地温雅含蓄，言行举止彬彬有礼，进退有度，眉宇间自带一股名门世家的雍容气度，待人谦和有礼，从无半分骄矜之色，与谁相处都让人如沐春风。
唯有他身边的小仆秋桐，不过十三四岁年纪，眉眼清秀，涉世未深，心思单纯，活泼可爱，像一只不知忧愁的小鸟，一路上叽叽喳喳，好奇地问东问西，为这一行江湖侠客的旅途，平添了几分少年稚气的暖意。
六人之中，唯独萧无恨最是特别。
他始终沉默寡言，极少主动开口说话，大多时候只是独自静坐一旁，静静听众人谈笑，眼神清冷，周身透着一股拒人千里的孤冷疏离。众人见他性情孤僻冷傲，也不敢过多打扰，平日里与他交流甚少。唯有温心察言的林之水，偶尔会主动轻声问他几句闲话，萧无恨便简短地答上几句，不多说一字，也不多露半分情绪。
这日傍晚，一行人寻了一处山间驿站歇脚。夜色渐深，月光如水，洒在寂静的庭院之中。
秋桐伺候林之水歇下，见左右无人，便凑到自家公子身边，压低声音，一脸困惑地悄悄问道：“公子，您一路上对那位萧公子格外温和关照，可他却总是对您爱理不理的，一张脸冷得像寒冬寒冰一样，半点情面都不给。您为何还要对他那般好呢？”
林之水望着窗外清冷月色，唇角勾起一抹温和浅笑，轻声解释道：“秋桐，你不懂。这位萧公子，绝非天生冷漠无情之人。他这般刻意封闭自己，沉默寡言，必定是早年经历过常人难以想象的惊天变故，心中藏着深重的伤痛与苦衷，才不得不将自己层层包裹，隔绝尘世温暖。”
他顿了顿，语气愈发笃定：“你别看他外表冰冷如霜，其实他内心深处，比谁都要善良柔软，也比谁都敏感细腻。这样的人，一旦认定真心，便是一生一世的挚友，是这江湖之上，真正值得倾心相交的君子知己。”
秋桐似懂非懂地点点头，心中却依旧有些不解，只觉得自家公子看人，总是比旁人要通透深刻许多。
这番对话，静坐月下风中的萧无恨自然未曾听闻。若是他有幸听到林之水这番洞悉人心的言语，那颗常年冰封、孤寂封闭的心，不知会掀起怎样的惊涛骇浪。
此刻，他独自静坐驿站庭院的青石之上，夜风微凉，拂动他单薄的衣袂。月色溶溶，洒在他孤峭的身影上，更显落寞。
萧无恨缓缓从怀中取出一支古朴无华的玉箫，箫身温润，泛着淡淡月光。他将玉箫凑近唇边，指尖轻按音孔，缓缓吹奏起来。
只听一阵悠悠清鸣破空而起，箫声清越绵长，如空山流泉，如月下清风，在寂静夜色中缓缓飘散，回荡四野。那声音之中，少了几分往日的苍凉悲戚，却多了几分遗世独立的清越高绝，似有心事随风散，又有孤怀对月明。
清越箫声，在夜色中悠悠回荡，穿透了驿站的寂静。
没过多久，屋外廊下脚步声轻响，又多了一道身影。正是中年文士杨凡。他循着箫声而来，站在月光之下，静静聆听片刻，眼中涌起几分豪情与感慨。忽然抬手按住腰间长剑，随着萧无恨的箫声节拍，仰首弹剑，放声长歌——

“水天空阔，恨东风、不借世间英物。蜀鸟吴花残照里，忍见荒城颓壁。铜雀春清，金人秋泪，此恨凭谁雪？堂堂剑气，斗牛空认奇杰。”
歌声苍凉豪迈，慷慨激越，正是南宋文天祥那首气壮山河的《酹江月》。字里行间，尽是家国之恨、英雄壮志、满腔孤愤。箫声清越相和，歌声慷慨激昂，一箫一剑，一柔一刚，在月夜之下交织相融，直穿云霄。
清越箫声与慷慨歌声，很快惊动了驿站内歇息的众人。
林之水率先推门而出，白衣胜雪，立于月下；紧接着蓝继仁也笑着迈步走出，彭天横紧随其后，护在左右。几人皆被这月夜箫歌所吸引，静静站在廊下，凝神聆听，随着节拍轻轻击掌相合。
歌声激昂处，箫声亦随之高亢；歌声沉郁处，箫声便婉转低回。
唱到豪情万丈之处，林之水眼中精光一闪，胸中剑意涌动，忍不住朗声一笑，手腕一翻，腰间长剑应声出鞘。剑光清冽，映着月色，他足尖一点，身形飘然跃起，在月光之下翩然舞剑。
一时间，月夜庭院之中，景象绝美——
一人静坐吹箫，箫声清越高远；
一人弹剑作歌，歌声慷慨激越；
一人月下舞剑，身姿飘逸如仙；
其余众人击掌相和，心意相通。
content_en:
The storm subsided, and the five people and one servant embarked on a journey south of the Yangtze River. Xiao Wuhen, Lin Zhishui, Yang Fan, Lan Jiren, Peng Tianheng, and Lin Zhishui's servant Qiutong, a group of six people walked together on Jianghu Road, spending the night at dawn, accompanied by wind and rain.
Along the way, there are beautiful mountains and rivers with different scenery. Sometimes we pass through green mountains and green waters, and sometimes we pass through cities and towns. Everyone got along day and night, chatting about everything, drinking and having fun, ranging from anecdotes about rivers and lakes to poetry and songs, from mountains and rivers geography to martial arts anecdotes. Several people who were strangers to each other at first gradually became familiar with each other day and night, and they became congenial, and actually developed a feeling of being close friends who regretted meeting each other so late.
Yang Fan, a disciple of Dian Cang, is free and uninhibited by nature, upright and upright, and his conversation is humorous. He has both the character of a scholar and the heroic spirit of a chivalrous person. He is calm and responsible when dealing with things. He has won the admiration and trust of everyone along the way.
Although the wealthy businessman Lan Jiren was born as a merchant, he was not tacky at all. He was a warm-hearted, generous and cheerful person. He loved joking with the young people around him and often made Qiu Tong laugh. He added a lot of laughter along the way, which made the dullness disappear.
The personal guard beside him, Peng Tianheng, had a different look. This master of the Five Tiger Door-Breaking Knife has always been silent, his right hand is always pressed firmly on the handle of the knife at his waist, and he never leaves Lan Jiren's side. A pair of tiger eyes are always scanning the surroundings vigilantly, not letting go of the grass, trees, wind, or sound. Like a calm and reliable patron saint, he isolates all potential dangers.
Lin Zhishui was as gentle and reserved as ever, polite in his words and deeds, and measured in his advances and retreats. There was a graceful demeanor from a well-known family in his brows. He was courteous and courteous to others, without any hint of arrogance. He made everyone feel like spring breeze when he got along with him.
Only the servant Qiutong beside him was only thirteen or fourteen years old, with delicate features, inexperienced, simple-minded, lively and cute, like a little bird that knew no sorrow. He chirped and curiously asked questions along the way, adding a bit of childish warmth to the journey of this group of knights and knights.
Among the six, only Xiao Wuhen was the most special.
He was always taciturn and rarely took the initiative to speak. Most of the time he just sat quietly by himself, listening to people talking and laughing quietly. His eyes were cold, and his whole body exuded a sense of loneliness and alienation. Seeing that he was lonely and arrogant, everyone did not dare to disturb him too much, and they rarely communicated with him on weekdays. Only Lin Zhishui, who was gentle and observant, would occasionally take the initiative to ask him a few gossips in a low voice, and Xiao Wuhen would answer briefly without saying a word more or showing any emotion.
That evening, the group found a mountain station to rest. The night is getting darker, and the moonlight is like water, shining in the silent courtyard.
Qiu Tong waited for Lin Zhishui to rest. Seeing that there was no one around, she moved closer to her young master, lowered her voice, and asked quietly with a confused look on her face: "Sir, you were particularly gentle and caring to that young master Xiao along the way, but he always ignored you. His face was as cold as winter ice, and he didn't show any affection to him. Why are you still so nice to him?"
Lin Zhishui looked out the window at the cold moonlight, with a gentle smile on his lips, and explained softly: "Qiu Tong, you don't understand. This Young Master Xiao is by no means a cold and heartless person by nature. He is so deliberately closed off and silent. He must have experienced unimaginable unimaginable changes in his early years, and he has deep pain and suffering in his heart, so he has to wrap himself up in layers to isolate himself from the warmth of the world."
He paused, and his tone became more determined: "Don't look at him as cold as frost on the outside, but deep down, he is kinder, softer, and more sensitive than anyone else. Such a person, once he is sincere, will be a lifelong friend. He is a gentleman and confidant in this world who is truly worthy of friendship."
Qiu Tong nodded with some understanding, but she was still a little confused in her heart. She just felt that her young master always looked at people much more clearly and profoundly than others.
This conversation, JingXiao Wuhen, who was sitting in the moonlight and in the wind, naturally never heard of it. If he was lucky enough to hear Lin Zhishui's words that penetrated people's hearts, he didn't know what kind of storm would be set off in his heart that had been frozen and lonely all year round.
At this moment, he was sitting alone on the bluestone in the courtyard of the inn, with the cool night breeze blowing his thin clothes. The moonlight shines softly on his lonely figure, making him look even more lonely.
Xiao Wuhen slowly took out a simple jade flute from his arms. The flute's body was warm and glowing with a faint moonlight. He brought the jade flute close to his lips, lightly pressed the sound hole with his fingertips, and began to play slowly.
Just listen to a long and clear sound rising through the sky, the sound of the flute is clear and long, like a spring flowing in an empty mountain, like the breeze under the moon, slowly drifting in the silent night, echoing all over the place. In that voice, there was less of the desolation and sorrow of the past, but more of the purity and independence of the world. It seemed that the thoughts were scattered with the wind, and there was a loneliness towards the bright moon.
The clear sound of the flute echoed in the night, penetrating the silence of the inn.
Not long after, there were soft footsteps on the corridor outside the house, and another figure appeared. It is Yang Fan, a middle-aged scribe. He followed the sound of the flute, stood under the moonlight, and listened quietly for a moment, with a bit of pride and emotion in his eyes. Suddenly he raised his hand and held down the long sword at his waist. Following the rhythm of Xiao Wuhen's flute, he raised his head to play the sword and sang a long song——
"The water and sky are vast, I hate the east wind and don't borrow the world's heroes. In the Sichuan birds and Wu flowers, I can't bear to see the decaying walls of the deserted city. The bronze bird is clear in spring, and the golden man sheds tears in autumn. Who can express this hatred? The majestic sword spirit, the bullfighting sky recognizes the outstanding heroes."
The song is desolate, heroic, impassioned and impassioned, just like the magnificent "Moon Over the River" by Wen Tianxiang of the Southern Song Dynasty. Between the lines, there is hatred of family and country, heroic aspirations, and loneliness and anger. The sound of the flute is clear and harmonious, the singing is impassioned, one flute and one sword, one soft and one strong, intertwined and blended under the moonlit night, straight through the sky.
The sound of Qingyue flute and generous singing soon startled everyone who was resting in the post station.
Lin Zhishui was the first to push open the door and walk out, dressed in white as snow, standing under the moon; then Lan Jiren walked out with a smile, followed closely by Peng Tianheng, guarding him on the left and right. Several people were attracted by this moonlit flute song. They stood quietly in the corridor, listened attentively, and clapped their hands to the beat.
Where the singing is passionate, the flute sounds louder; where the singing is melancholy, the flute sounds gentle and low.
When he reached the point of singing with great passion, Lin Zhishui's eyes flashed, and the sword intent surged in his chest. He couldn't help but laugh loudly, flipped his wrist, and the long sword at his waist was unsheathed. The sword light was clear and reflected the moonlight. He pointed his toes, leaped up and danced the sword gracefully under the moonlight.
For a moment, the scene in the courtyard on a moonlit night was absolutely beautiful——
One person sits quietly and plays the flute, and the sound of the flute becomes clearer and higher and farther away;
One man plays the sword and composes a song, his singing is impassioned and impassioned;
A man is dancing with a sword under the moonlight, his figure is as graceful as a fairy;
The rest of the people high-fived each other and felt connected.
